title: Witch circles in the forest
content: I also just stumbled on this sub and want to ask if anyone’s dreamed of this place because it haunts me. It’s a band of forest, evergreens pine trees. Beyond the forest is a cliff and an ocean with water so cold and blue. Sometimes there are boats in it. I want to talk about the forest in this post though. When I visit, it’s always night. I know intuitively there is a boarding school(?) nearby. There is a feeling that something is off about the boarding school…. Something living in the woods. But this particular part of the forest is full of witch circles. I mean literally circles of witches, surrounding little bonfires. Some of them are dancing and drinking and the vibe is fun, and exciting… but if you go deeper into the woods the circles get grimmer and darker and the witches are sleeping next to some of the fires. It gets kind of scary before I wake up.
